headline: Papua New Guinea Inflation Hits 7%, Prompting Warning of Christmas Price Hikes
summary: ANZ Research reported that Papua New Guinea's annual inflation reached 7%, its highest level since 2011, raising consumer cost pressures ahead of the holidays.
why: Inflation dynamics in Pacific island nations impact import costs, exchange rates, and living standards.

impacts.name: Papua New Guinea
impacts.why: Headline inflation rate rose to a multi-year peak of 7%.
